name: Yamamura Misa Suspense: Kyoto Kurama-yama Sou Satsujin Jiken
original_name: 山村美紗サスペンス 京都鞍馬山荘殺人事件
source:
Kyouto Anba Sansou Satsujin Jiken is a murder mystery adventure game based on writings of Misa Yamamura, a Japanese writer of murder mystery novels. The protagonist of the story is Akiko Sonoyama, freelancer who finds herself in the middle of a murder mystery after the son of the host dies during the dinner right after drinking the wine.

Remake of the 3D0 original. The main difference there is that live actors have all been removed and characters were replaced with silhouettes and game interface changed to look like a mystery visual novel but with a selectable actions such as talk or inquire which make the game less of a typical visual novel and only resemble it in graphical presentation by using static backgrounds with dialogue text over it.

[from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/yamamura-misa-suspense-kyto-anba-sans-satsujin-jiken]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《山村美纱悬疑：京都鞍马山庄杀人事件》是一款推理冒险游戏，改编自日本推理小说家山村美纱的作品。主人公园山秋子是一名自由职业者，庄园主人家的儿子在晚宴上喝下葡萄酒后死亡，她因此被卷入杀人谜案。

本作为3DO原版的重制版。主要变化是移除了真人演员，以剪影替代角色；游戏界面也改成了推理视觉小说风格，但加入了“交谈”“询问”等可选行动，使本作不再是典型的视觉小说，只在图像表现上保留静态背景与对话文字。

[来源：[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/yamamura-misa-suspense-kyto-anba-sans-satsujin-jiken]Moby Games[/url]]
